answer: Like mineral crystallization, network trust precipitates through recursive peer-attestation staking. A rogue identity seeks a violet dawn of false consensus, yet finding a haven requires depositing scarce collateral rooted in verified compute. Validated nodes grow immutable as jade lattices; forging clone clusters triggers superlinear slashing penalties where forging n identities imposes an O(n²) bonding cost, suffocating counterfeit growth.
